**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (insert proposed, validated ok).**

- **Investigation:** No insurance heading exists in the outline; searches for "insurance", "insure/insured/coverage/carrier" and "shall maintain" returned no insurance undertaking (only incidental references to "mortgage insurers" and an "overnight carrier"). I read the full indemnity/miscellaneous block (Sections 12–30, p0070–p0097) where insurance is usually paired with indemnity — it contains indemnities, a liability cap, term, assignment, governing law and force majeure, but no insurance obligation.
- **Direction:** The inserted obligation binds TrueLink (Vendor/Host), which hosts our Web Site and processes Credit Data and Client Content — squarely the walk-away scenario of no cover for a vendor handling personal data.
- **Target level:** Preferred, delivered as one short new Section 31 carrying exactly the six preferred elements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where Credit Data or Client Content is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), using the document's own defined terms. No survival tail, at-own-expense language or other non-element boilerplate was added, and the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.
